L31·N7697unmasked layer
This neuron is essentially a whitespace/formatting-boundary detector: its (weak) positive activations land on separator characters — a literal tab (ĉ), a line-break, a space just before a year/number, or the hyphen inside a split compound — while the same class of tokens (bullet "•", newline after a heading/title line) drives it strongly negative, so it mainly encodes the polarity of document-segment delimiters rather than any semantic content.
